note: Two campgrounds about 1 km apart on wooded ground above Fort Patrick Henry Lake: the Main Campground (sites 1-94, water and electric) and Moody Bluff (sites 101-140, full hookups, the big-rig sites). Many Main sites are listed at 16-30 ft, so check the site's length when booking. A separate hammock campground has four primitive sites. --Claude
summary: Warriors' Path checked on the camping page, park map and 7 two-week reservation-calendar windows: 132 RV sites (93 Main W/E, 39 Moody Bluff full hookup, 8-9 pull-through, rigs to 75 ft), $32 base confirmed, high $48 -> $65 (holiday weekends); year-round; phone added 423-239-8531; not waterfront held.
flags: SPLIT CANDIDATE (borderline): the entry covers two campgrounds with different hookups ~0.9-1.0 km apart: Main Campground ~36.4971,-82.4798 (sites 1-94, water/electric, $32-34 base) and Moody Bluff ~36.5028,-82.4879 (sites 101-140, full hookups/50 A, $40-42 base). Reviewer's call under the ~1 km rule.

PIN: stored 36.49887,-82.48721 is at the park headquarters, ~680 m from the Main Campground and ~450 m from Moody Bluff. If kept as one entry, suggest moving to the Main Campground ~36.4971,-82.4798 (~690 m move).

SITE LENGTHS: Main sites list max RV 16-40 ft (80 and 90 at 16 ft; 1-3 at 20 ft); most Main sites and all Moody Bluff sites fit 23 ft. Catalog max for Moody Bluff site 108 is 77 ft; the park page says 75 (75 written).
PULL-THROUGH: calendar marks 8 (111-118), the park page says nine.
WATERFRONT not waterfront held: both campgrounds sit under continuous canopy above the lake (Moody Bluff on the bluff ~100 m back; Main's south-edge sites ~30-45 m from the water through woods).
